note: Reference-only pins of the qualification-side execution profiles that the committed model-adaptive profiles bind to. They are NOT a second authority for execution profiles and they are NOT a new qualification surface: the canonical contract stays core/contracts/execution-profile.schema.json and the qualification-side instances stay where the qualification lane owns them (runtime/cli/specs/reference-audit-v1.json holds the committed instance used here). The pins exist so the model-adaptive equivalence check can anchor the authority and completion semantics of a profile without reaching into runtime state. A pin that contradicts the canonical contract fails the store load closed.

profile_readonly_v1.description: Read-only analysis profile (reference-only pin; the committed instance is owned by the qualification lane in runtime/cli/specs/reference-audit-v1.json).
